column1: # A strict subset of lomo_def_b015.tsv, so every cell already has a trained LOMO
# flow and an existing functional number to sit beside.
# COMPOSITION IS 5 VERTICES + 5 INTERIOR, AND THE TWO ARE NEVER POOLED. A one-hot
# mixture is the most extreme point the design contains and vertex cells run ~10x
# the interior's functional error, so a subset that mixes them reads high for a
# reason that has nothing to do with the generator. Here the
# split is structural rather than checked: report_bench.py decides the stratum from
# The five interior cells are the QUINTILE MEDIANS of nn_l1 over the 80 interior
# rows of lomo_def_b015.tsv, sorted ascending, at indices 8/24/40/56/72 --
# 0.173..0.469. Pre-registered before any benchmark was scored.
